title: Fix iOS foregrounding — foreground-app reports wrong bundle ID, screenshots land on SpringBoard instead of target app
acceptanceCriteria: simemu do s-xxx screenshot always captures the target app, not SpringBoard
foreground-app returns the correct bundle ID for the session app
Retry logic: if first attempt lands on SpringBoard, retries with explicit app activation
Tested with at least 3 different iOS apps (FitKind, Sitches, Vivii)
Does NOT regress boot/booted state detection
